clients.title: Selected client diagnostics
clients.confirmMessage: You selected {{count}} clients. Each client is issued a token and makes a small number of Graph requests.

remedies.connectEntra: Connect Microsoft Entra from Settings > Integrations > Entra.
remedies.selectAppRegistration: Select a Microsoft app registration for Entra, then reconnect.
remedies.selectExistingApp: The bound Microsoft app no longer exists. Select an existing app registration, then reconnect.
remedies.chooseAnotherApp: The bound Microsoft app registration is archived. Choose another app registration, then reconnect.
remedies.addEntraCapability: Edit the app registration in Settings > Integrations > Microsoft and enable the Entra capability.
remedies.secretExpiryUnknown: Client secret expiry is unknown. Microsoft client secrets expire in 6-24 months; rotate on schedule in Azure.
remedies.clientSecretMissing: The app registration client secret is missing or empty. Rotate the secret in Azure and update the app registration in Settings > Integrations > Microsoft.
remedies.entraAccessDenied: Access to Entra diagnostics is denied for this user or workspace.
remedies.temporalUnreachable: The Temporal frontend could not be reached. Automatic sync cannot run until it is available.
remedies.temporalNoWorkers: Temporal is reachable but no worker is polling the Entra task queue. Scheduled syncs will not be processed.
remedies.syncDisabled: Automatic Entra sync is turned off for this workspace.
remedies.scheduleLookupFailed: The Temporal schedule could not be inspected. Verify Temporal permissions and connectivity.
remedies.scheduleMissing: Automatic sync is enabled but no Temporal schedule was found. Save the schedule to apply it.
remedies.scheduleIntervalMismatch: The Temporal schedule interval ({{interval}} min) does not match the saved setting ({{configured}} min). Save the schedule to reconcile it.
remedies.reconnectEntra: No refresh token is stored. Reconnect Microsoft Entra.
remedies.noManagedTenants: No managed tenants were returned. The partner must be onboarded to Microsoft 365 Lighthouse with active GDAP relationships.
remedies.mappedTenantMissing: Mapped tenant "{{client}}" was not returned by discovery. GDAP may have expired or been terminated.
remedies.cippCredentialsMissing: CIPP base URL and API token are required. Configure them on the Connection tab.
remedies.cippAuthRejected: CIPP rejected the API credential. Rotate the CIPP API key from Settings > CIPP > API access; this is not an Azure client secret.
remedies.cippEmptyTenantList: CIPP returned no tenants. Check CIPP customer visibility and configuration.
remedies.cippUnreachable: CIPP could not be reached. Verify the base URL, DNS/TLS, and outbound connectivity.
remedies.cippPerTenantFailed: CIPP could not read this tenant directory.
remedies.consecutiveSyncFailures: The last two syncs did not complete successfully. Review the sync history and per-tenant errors.
remedies.reconciliationOpenItems: Review queue has {{count}} item(s) waiting; ambiguous matches are never auto-linked.
remedies.customerConsentRequired: The app needs admin consent in this customer tenant. Reconnecting the partner will not help; open the consent link and grant consent as the customer admin.
remedies.entitlementGroupNotSecurity: The configured entitlement group is not a security group; membership may not be enforceable.
remedies.entitlementGroupMissing: The configured entitlement group no longer exists in this customer tenant.
remedies.allUsersExcluded: Every user in this directory was excluded by the current filter rules; sync would create no contacts.
remedies.yieldTruncated: The yield preview stopped early because the directory is large. Counts are a lower bound, not the full directory.
remedies.yieldFailed: The yield preview could not be computed.
remedies.missingScope: The token is missing {{scope}}. Grant admin consent, then reconnect Microsoft Entra.
remedies.appClientIdMismatch: The token was issued to a different application than the bound app registration. Reconnect Microsoft Entra with the correct app.
remedies.client_secret_invalid: Microsoft rejected the app credential (invalid_client / AADSTS7000222). Rotate the client secret in Azure, update the Microsoft app registration in Settings > Integrations > Microsoft, then reconnect.
remedies.app_not_found: Microsoft could not find the application (AADSTS700016). Verify the bound client id and that the app is multi-tenant.
remedies.partner_consent_required: Partner-tenant admin consent is missing (AADSTS65001 / consent_required). Grant admin consent for the app in the partner tenant, then reconnect.
remedies.conditional_access: Conditional Access blocked the request (AADSTS50076/AADSTS50079). The connecting account must satisfy MFA/compliant-device policy.
remedies.refresh_token_invalid: The refresh grant is expired or revoked. Reconnect Microsoft Entra to issue a new refresh token.
remedies.tenant_not_found: Microsoft could not resolve the tenant (AADSTS90002). Verify the tenant id in the connection or mapping.
remedies.account_not_allowed: The connecting account is not allowed in the tenant (AADSTS50020). Verify the account has access or is a guest.
remedies.network_unreachable: Microsoft Graph could not be reached. Check outbound connectivity, DNS, and TLS trust.
remedies.token_rejected: Microsoft rejected the token (401). Reconnect Microsoft Entra or verify the customer consent.
remedies.forbidden: Microsoft Graph returned 403 (Forbidden). Verify delegated permissions, consent, and role assignments.
remedies.request_failed: The Microsoft request failed. Expand the step for the error code and correlation id.
remedies.customer_directory_role_missing: Microsoft Graph denied a customer directory read (403). The delegated account needs a directory-read role in this customer tenant, typically assigned through GDAP (for example Directory Readers).
remedies.managedTenantsEndpointFault: Graph rejected the managedTenants request; this is an Alga-side endpoint fault. Contact support with the request id.
remedies.cippHttpError: CIPP answered with HTTP {{status}} for every tenant-list endpoint. This is a CIPP-side list failure, not an empty tenant list.
remedies.cippInvalidPayload: CIPP returned a response that is not a tenant list. Verify the CIPP-API version and endpoint.
remedies.schedulePaused: Automatic sync is enabled but the Temporal schedule is paused; no runs will fire.
remedies.temporalWorkerUnknown: Temporal is reachable but worker poller evidence is unavailable; worker availability could not be confirmed.
